subject: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request

Hi Laura / Monica,

Heads-up — Rajesh (P6 SWE, infra team) resigned effective 11/20 and has accelerated his final week. He's the primary owner of the KV cache project and the service-level rollout for our new batching layer. The team has flagged customer-impacting risk if we leave the seat unfilled while we continue the rollout.

I know we are under the hiring freeze, but after triage with the infra leads we recommend a short-term headcount exception to convert one near-term hire (P6 SWE) to a replacement for Rajesh. The attached replacement_plan_20261115.pdf outlines scope, coverage plan, and a 6-week ramp expectation. I also included the updated org chart (org_chart_v3.png).

Asks:
- Approval to request a freeze exception for 1 FTE (P6 SWE) and start recruiter outreach this week.
- Allow a short-term contractor overlap (2 weeks) budgeted from infra contingency if we need immediate coverage.

Impact summary (short):
- Technical: KV cache rollout will be delayed ~3–4 weeks if seat remains vacant; risk to two enterprise customers' latency SLOs.
- Financial: expected < $45k overrun (contractor + expedited recruiter fee) vs. cost of missed SLA credits.

Please advise if we should escalate to Markus for approval. I can jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: replacement_plan_20261115.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: org_chart_v3.png (image/png)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request

Thanks for the context, Aditya. Short reply while I dig into numbers —

1) Please add a one-paragraph business impact justification (inc. customers at risk and estimated SLA exposure $). We'll include that in the exception packet.
2) Monica — can you confirm if we have available budget in infra contingency for a 2-week contractor overlap + recruiter expedited fee? If not, what's the closest alternative?

Markus — looping you in because this is a post-freeze exception that likely needs VP sign-off. If you want, we can put a 10m sync on your calendar today.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: recruiting@talentpartners.io, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request

Laura / Aditya —

Budget check: we have a $50k buffer in infra contingency this quarter (unallocated). That covers a 2-week contractor overlap at market rates and a 15% expedited recruiter fee for a one-time search. I can reallocate internally but need Finance to sign off on the transfer before we spend. I propose:

- Approve contractor overlap now (up to $20k) as an interim charge to infra contingency.
- I'll start the expedited search with Talent Partners (cc'd) pending VP approval for the FTE replacement.

Talent Partners note (recruiting@talentpartners.io): if we brief them tonight, they can present 3 screened candidates by 11/30 and support an accelerated on-site process.

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: recruiting_timeline_rapid_hire.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request

Thanks all for the quick analysis. I reviewed Aditya's replacement plan and Monica's budget note. Approve a temporary headcount exception for 1 P6 SWE to replace Rajesh with the following conditions:

1) Exception scope: replace 1x P6 SWE only; do not expand team size beyond baseline.
2) Budget: Monica may use up to $20k from infra contingency immediately for contractor overlap; any additional contingency spend requires Finance sign-off.
3) Timeline: initiate expedited search tonight; present shortlist by 11/30; target offer by 12/7.
4) Quality gate: final offer requires a short risk review with Evelyn (customer impact) to confirm we aren't compensating for product deficiencies with staffing.

Laura — please mark the exception in our freeze tracker and notify Finance. Monica — proceed with Talent Partners and loop Finance. Aditya — work with Evelyn on the risk review doc (1 pager) and share by EOD 11/20. I'll sign the formal exception packet once the 1-pager is attached.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, recruiting@talentpartners.io
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: P6 SWE replacement — headcount exception request

Markus / all — thanks, appreciate the quick sign-off. Per your directions:

- I've drafted the 1-page risk review and attached it here. Highlights: two enterprise customers at risk (ACME and ModuPay), potential SLA credit exposure estimated ~$120k over 6 weeks if rollout is blocked. Mitigation: contractor overlap + focused scope cut to KV cache rollout for non-critical tenants.
- Monica: please confirm contractor booking this afternoon and that Talent Partners has the brief (they do).
- Laura: please add to the freeze tracker and notify Finance for the contingency transfer.

I'll follow up after the recruiter presents candidates.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
